class.name: SuperposSpawnCatalog
class.brief_description: Bounded allowlist of schema and resource pairs for a spawner.
class.description: Holds at most 64 [SuperposSpawnEntry] resources. [method SuperposSpawner.start] captures an immutable native snapshot, so later edits to this resource do not change an attached receiver. Validation never instantiates a scene, resolves a node path, inspects a script property list or executes a gameplay getter. Script-extended catalogs and entries are rejected.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns a Dictionary containing [code]error[/code], [code skip-lint]entries[/code] (the admitted entry count, or 0 on error) and [code]projection[/code], which is always [code]"sequential"[/code]. Zero, duplicate or out-of-range identifiers, path escapes and malformed field mappings return an [enum Error] code.

members.member: Entries in this catalog. Setting and reading copy the array.
